name: iron-meridian-1936-trailer
description: Cinematic 1936 grand-strategy world map trailer built with Remotion

scripts.build:map: npm run fetch:data && node --max-old-space-size=8000 scripts/build-map.mjs && python3 scripts/compose-map.py
scripts.build:assets: npm run build:map && npm run build:audio
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Trailer out/trailer_master.mp4 && bash scripts/compress.sh out/trailer_master.mp4 output/trailer.mp4
scripts.render:root: npm run render && mkdir -p /output && cp output/trailer.mp4 /output/trailer.mp4
